gaps.title: Production object storage and presigner adapters
gaps.completion_gate: Bind ObjectReadPort, ExportObjectStorePort and ObjectDownloadSigner to production NODE-18/object-storage infrastructure, prove exact-object checksum reads, internal-only storage metadata, TTL enforcement and that signed URLs never enter persistence or logs.

gaps.title: Real format conversion renderers
gaps.completion_gate: Implement and accept real PNG/JPEG conversion, MP4 normalization, PDF export and PPTX/PDF deck rendering behind ExportRendererPort. Same-format copy-through is implemented; byte renaming is explicitly forbidden.

gaps.title: NODE-11 production permission backend
gaps.completion_gate: Bind Node11ExportAuthorizationAdapter to the authoritative project/artifact permission service and prove cross-tenant, revoked-access and post-export download reauthorization cases.

gaps.title: NODE-19 worker crash/replay acceptance
gaps.completion_gate: Run export.package workers through durable claims, cancellation, retry/DLQ and restart scenarios; prove deterministic runtime-job dedupe and package/output idempotency under crashes between object write and repository commit.

gaps.title: Hosted and live infrastructure acceptance
gaps.completion_gate: Execute NODE-49 contract, quality, PostgreSQL and 500-item benchmark gates on hosted runners and complete live image/video/PDF/ZIP/object-storage/download acceptance. If the existing GitHub Actions Billing/Spending Limit blocker persists, clear it before claiming hosted green.
